review_evidence: Reviewed the 16-file pinned snapshot and the public UnicodeBasic API.
UnicodeBasic.lean and supporting modules define Unicode property types, lookups, character-category operations, and executable table interfaces.
Utility/table-generation Lean files participate in this formal/executable specification surface; no lossless formal-source exclusion was established.
summary: Retain lean4-unicode-basic as a formal/executable Unicode specification and lookup library.
